decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper extends the firm's core construction offer, uses its existing engineering, service and dealer resources, and shows no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search one year after launch.
The articulated dumper builds on the established range and still has its own web presence, so with slack from a mature portfolio the firm can carry it while its results are still uncertain.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core and carries higher risk of falling short of aspirations, but it serves a niche close to the firm's underground expertise and is too new to judge, so it is kept for now.
The multi-model telescopic loader line is a substantial investment close to the core business, which makes withdrawal within a year unlikely absent clear underperformance.
